title: Curlew RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Curlew Rv park over looks the Kettle River and has some amazing sunset and if your lucky you can see the northern lights. The Spots or Spacious and the Rv Park is spread out over 10 acres. There are seasonal bathrooms/showers and laundry. We have a play ground and a gazebo for hanging out or hosting an event.
